newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-DAVIES BACK FOR INJURY-HIT WALES.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-DAVIES BACK FOR INJURY-HIT WALES.

text.p: Former captain Jonathan Davies will face England one more time this weekend after being named on Thursday in a Welsh side containing five enforced changes from the one narrowly beaten by France last month.
Davies, 34, has announced this will be his final Welsh appearance before he retires, but he will make his Five Nations farewell without a number of injured colleagues.
Ieuan Evans (calf and hamstring), Scott Gibbs (neck spasms) and Colin Charvis (groin infection) are all ruled out, along with fly-half Arwel Thomas (knee) and lock Mark Rowley who has a broken wrist.
In come Cardiff wing Simon Hill, Llanelli duo Nigel Davies and Mike Voyle and Ebbw Vale flanker Kingsley Jones.
There is a chance the recalled Davies could find himself opposite Rob Andrew, recalled to the England bench a decade after he and Davies last opposed each other at the Arms Park.

Team: 15-Neil Jenkins; 14-Simon Hill, 13-Allan Bateman, 12-Nigel Davies, 11-Gareth Thomas; 10-Jonathan Davies, 9-Rob Howley; 8-Scott Quinnell, 7-Kingsley Jones, 6-Steve Williams, 5-Mike Voyle, 4-Gareth Llewellyn, 3-David Young, 2-Jonathan Humphreys (captain), 1-Christian Loader.
Replacements: Spencer John, Garin Jenkins, Dale McIntosh, Craig Quinnell, Paul John, Wayne Proctor,
